reproduction_target: The de novo PacBio HiFi genome assembly of Melo melo (2.29 Gb, N50 18.6 Mb, BUSCO 92.4% metazoa_odb10), its repeat/gene annotation, and the downstream comparative-genomic claims: the early-branching phylogenomic placement of Volutidae within Neogastropoda (IQ-TREE2 supermatrix tree, Figure 4), the CAFE5 gene-family expansion/contraction counts (2443 expansions / 219 contractions on the M. melo lineage, Figure 5), and the reported expansions of metallopeptidase, conotoxin-like, ion-channel, CYP450, ABC-transporter, C1q and LRR families plus the absence of nacre-related genes.
granularity_note: Coarse prose-derived step list: one step per named tool / analysis invocation in MATERIALS AND METHODS, plus CAFE5 which is named only in RESULTS (no Methods subsection). Params scoring policy applied uniformly: 2 = all thresholds/flags explicitly given; 1 = 'default parameters' stated, or partial flags given, or a single domain-standard default invocation that is reconstructable by inference; 0 = invocation underdetermined (tool alternatives unresolved, procedure not described, or a critical input such as the ultrametric input tree for CAFE5 never specified). Version axis is capped at 1 for every step by the Stage-1 protocol (exact prose pins without environment closure = 1); tools with no version token at all score 0. Wet-lab steps (W) are OOS and carry no verdict weight.

steps.label: Raw PacBio HiFi read QC - FastQC v0.11.9 on raw HiFi reads
De novo genome assembly - Hifiasm v0.19.9-r616, 'default parameters'
Reference-guided scaffolding/correction/merging - RagTag v2.1.0 against Stramonita haemastoma GCA_030674155.1
Assembly summary + SnailPlot - BlobToolKit v4.4.2
Mitochondrial genome assembly - MitoHiFi (no version, no reference/params stated)
Mitogenome annotation - MITOS2 (no version, no genetic-code/reference setting stated)
Circular mitogenome visualisation - Proksee web server (hosted service, no version/access date)
Iso-Seq read processing to high-quality isoforms - PacBio Iso-Seq v4.0.0 pipeline, 'default parameters'
Genome completeness - BUSCO v5.7.1, metazoa_odb10 lineage set (odb10 release/date not pinned)
Assembly statistics (N50/L50/length/GC) - QUAST v5.3.0
Homology-based repeat masking - RepeatMasker v4.1.7-p1 with Repbase libraries (Repbase release not pinned; subscription-gated)
De novo repeat discovery/modeling - RepeatModeler v2.0.6 (no flags stated; -LTRStruct status unknown)
Structural gene prediction - BRAKER2 v2.1.6 with GeneMark-ETP + AUGUSTUS (component versions and training config unstated; GeneMark is license-key gated)
Iso-Seq transcript alignment to repeat-masked assembly - Minimap2 v2.17, -ax splice
Protein redundancy clustering + length filter - CD-HIT v4.8.1, 95% identity, sequences <150 aa excluded
Domain/functional annotation - InterProScan v5.59-91.0 (Pfam/SMART/PANTHER member-DB releases not stated), e-value 1e-5
Homology annotation - BLASTp (BLAST+ v2.13.0) vs Swiss-Prot UniProtKB 2023_03 release, e-value 1e-5
KEGG pathway assignment via KAAS web server (no KAAS/KEGG release, no BBH/SBH method or gene-set choice stated)

Conotoxin candidate search - tblastn of literature-derived conotoxin references + Pfam PF02950 against the M. melo genome (query set not deposited as an identified artifact; BLAST version not restated for this step)
Conotoxin candidate filtering - HMMER v3.3, e-value threshold 1e-5
Conotoxin validation - HHpred + cross-check against ConoServer (both hosted resources; no version, no DB release, no thresholds, 'high-confidence matches' criterion undefined)
Public transcriptome read QC/adapter trimming - 'standard protocols (e.g., Trimmomatic or fastp)'; the tool actually used is not resolved
De novo transcriptome assembly of transcriptome-based taxa - Trinity, 'default parameters' (no version)
Gene-model prediction on transcriptome taxa + header standardisation - 'Gene models were predicted as required'; no tool named, no procedure described
Orthogroup inference across 22 molluscan taxa - OrthoFinder v2.5.4, MCL inflation 2.1 (taxon accessions only in Supplementary Table 3; no MCL/OrthoFinder seed)
Orthogroup filtering - uniqHaplo.pl (undeposited helper script, no version) + <100 aa removal + 75% taxon-occupancy cutoff
Orthogroup multiple alignment - MAFFT v7.520, --auto --maxiterate 1000
Alignment error filtering - HmmCleaner (no version, no cost/threshold settings)
Ambiguous-block trimming - BMGE v1.12 (entropy/gap-rate/matrix settings not stated; defaults implied)
Per-orthogroup gene-tree inference - FastTreeMP with gamma rate variation and -slow (no version, no seed, thread-count nondeterminism unaddressed)
Paralog pruning + contamination exclusion + supermatrix construction - PhyloPyPruner (no version; all six flags given)
Maximum-likelihood species tree - IQ-TREE2, -T AUTO -B 1000 --wbtl, ModelFinder ('MPF'), 1000 UFBoot replicates (no version, no seed, -T AUTO makes thread count host-dependent)
Ten-species orthology panel - OrthoFinder v2.5.4 + UpSet plot and five-neogastropod Venn diagram (plotting tool/library not named)

Gene family expansion/contraction - CAFE5 on orthogroup counts across ten gastropod genomes (named only in RESULTS; no Methods subsection, no version, no lambda/error model, and the required ultrametric input tree is never described)
Expansion validation - MAFFT re-alignment of gene families + Pfam conserved-domain confirmation against reference sequences (no version restated, no thresholds, family-grouping criterion undefined)
Sample collection - adult Melo melo, Bay of Bengal (Chandipur, Odisha, India), six tissues dissected into RNAlater, -80 C
HMW gDNA extraction and QC - Qiagen kit, Qubit 4.0 DNA HS, NanoDrop 2000, 1% agarose, Agilent FEMTO Pulse
PacBio SMRTbell library prep (Express Template Prep Kit 3.0, >5 kb size selection, Sequel IIe Binding Kit 3.2) and HiFi/CCS sequencing on one 8M SMRT Cell
Total RNA extraction and QC - TRIzol, NucleoSpin RNA Cleanup, Qubit RNA HS, NanoDrop 2000, Bioanalyzer 2100 RNA 6000 Nano (RIN)
Iso-Seq full-length cDNA synthesis (NEBNext Single Cell/Low Input), SMRTbell library (Binding Kit 3.1) and Sequel IIe CCS/HiFi sequencing of pooled six-tissue library

gaps.where: whole paper - no Code Availability statement anywhere; Supplementary Data names only https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.17490824 holding 'All FASTA sequences, Pfam annotation files, genome statistics, repeat counts, and the taxa list'
gaps.missing: No analysis code repository of any kind (no GitHub/GitLab/Bitbucket/Software Heritage). The Zenodo deposit is described by the authors as data and annotation products only, not scripts or workflow definitions. Every one of the 35 C-steps is therefore prose-only, capping the Code axis at 1 (reconstructable) for well-described steps and 0 where the procedure is not described.
gaps.how_to_close: Deposit the driver scripts / command lines for assembly, annotation, orthology and phylogenomics in a public repository with a tagged release, and cite it in a Code Availability section.

gaps.where: C5 MitoHiFi, C6 MITOS2, C7 Proksee, C18 KAAS, C21 HHpred/ConoServer, C22 Trimmomatic-or-fastp, C23 Trinity, C26 uniqHaplo.pl, C28 HmmCleaner, C30 FastTreeMP, C31 PhyloPyPruner, C32 IQ-TREE2, C34 CAFE5
gaps.missing: 2a - no version token at all for 13 of the 35 computational steps, including the two tools that produce the paper's headline evolutionary claims (IQ-TREE2 for the phylogenomic placement in Figure 4, CAFE5 for the 2443/219 expansion-contraction counts in Figure 5). This is the single largest driver of NI verdicts here: the remaining 22 steps do carry exact prose pins.
gaps.how_to_close: State the exact version (and build) of every tool, especially IQ-TREE2, CAFE5, PhyloPyPruner, FastTreeMP, MitoHiFi, MITOS2 and HmmCleaner.

gaps.where: C34 CAFE5 (described only in RESULTS 'Gene Family Evolution in Melo melo'); C22/C23/C24 transcriptome preprocessing of the 22-taxon panel
gaps.missing: Sub-pipelines externalised out of Methods. CAFE5 has no Methods subsection: the ultrametric/time-calibrated input tree it requires is never described anywhere in the paper (no MCMCtree/r8s/TimeTree step exists in the step list), nor is the lambda/error model. The transcriptome branch is compressed into 'raw reads were quality filtered and adapter-trimmed using standard protocols (e.g., Trimmomatic or fastp)' and 'Gene models were predicted as required'.
gaps.how_to_close: Add a Methods subsection for CAFE5 giving the input tree, how it was made ultrametric/calibrated, the lambda model and the significance cutoff; name the actual trimming and gene-prediction tools used per taxon.

gaps.where: C19 conotoxin reference query set; C26 uniqHaplo.pl
gaps.missing: Custom artefacts not deposited as identified objects. The conotoxin query set was assembled from three prior studies plus Pfam PF02950 but is not given as a versioned FASTA with per-sequence provenance (the Zenodo record claims 'All FASTA sequences' but its contents could not be verified - see liveness). uniqHaplo.pl is a helper script used for orthogroup filtering with no source, version or link.
gaps.how_to_close: Deposit the exact conotoxin query FASTA and the uniqHaplo.pl source used, both versioned.

gaps.where: C25 OrthoFinder/MCL, C30 FastTreeMP, C32 IQ-TREE2 (-T AUTO -B 1000 UFBoot)
gaps.missing: Stochastic steps with no random seed recorded. IQ-TREE2 ultrafast bootstrap and ModelFinder are seed-dependent, and '-T AUTO' additionally makes the thread count host-dependent, so support values and possibly topology cannot be reproduced exactly; best achievable is distributional agreement.
gaps.how_to_close: Record the seed (IQ-TREE2 -seed), fix the thread count instead of -T AUTO, and report the ModelFinder-selected model per partition.

gaps.where: C25, C33, C34, C22, C23 - the 21 comparative taxa and the 10-species CAFE5 panel
gaps.missing: Species-to-accession correspondence lives only in Supplementary Table 3 ('retrieved from NCBI and other public repositories'); the main text names no accession for the comparative panel, and the panel composition differs between the 22-taxon phylogenomic analysis and the 10-species orthology/CAFE5 analyses without an explicit membership list in the running text.
gaps.how_to_close: Give per-taxon accession + assembly/annotation version in a machine-readable table, and state explicitly which taxa enter each of the two panels.

gaps.where: C11 RepeatMasker/Repbase, C13 BRAKER2/GeneMark-ETP, C18 KEGG KAAS
gaps.missing: Registration-, subscription- or licence-gated resources on the annotation path. Repbase requires a paid subscription and its release is not pinned; GeneMark requires a licence key; KEGG/KAAS is a hosted service with restricted redistribution. None is fatal for an academically licensed reproducer, but each blocks a clean-room rerun.
gaps.how_to_close: Pin the Repbase release used (or switch to Dfam), record the GeneMark version/licence date, and record the KEGG release and KAAS method (BBH/SBH) plus the access date.

gaps.missing: Liveness of the only supplementary artefact repository could not be confirmed from this network: both the DOI redirect and the Zenodo REST API returned HTTP 403 'unusual traffic from your network' (a network-side block, NOT evidence of a dead record). All NCBI accessions resolved (verified via eutils, Count=1 each), so this is an isolated unverified artefact.
gaps.how_to_close: Re-check the Zenodo record from an unblocked network at Stage 2 and confirm whether it contains only data products (as the paper states) or also scripts.

gaps.missing: Five wet-lab steps (specimen collection from a single wild individual, HMW gDNA and total RNA extraction, PacBio SMRTbell library prep, Sequel IIe HiFi and Iso-Seq sequencing) are out of scope for computational reproduction. The single wild-caught specimen is not re-obtainable, so these steps are reproducible only downstream of the deposited SRA reads.
gaps.how_to_close: N/A - OOS by construction; the deposited SRA reads are the correct computational entry point.
